answer_1.quote: the model is trained on sets of cognates and their known proto-word, and is then tasked with predicting the proto-word for an unseen set of cognates.
answer_1.outputs: Reconstructed proto-word (Latin form) from cognate sets

answer_2.quote: Our main quantitative metric for evaluation is the edit distance between the reconstructed word and the gold Latin word. We report test set average edit distance and average normalized edit distance (divided by word length), as well as the percentage of instances with less than k edit operations...
